title: Регулярные заказы

rules.visibility: Creation only when published merchant recurringEnabled=true AND recurringAvailable=true AND active cloud. Hide entry when not enabled; existing schedules/history and pause/cancel management are retained, processing availability shown separately.
rules.entry: Profile -> Regular orders; current basket -> configure; completed order -> repeat regularly. Required confirmation also appears in profile immediately below name and in compact home order alert.
rules.modes: Reminder collects a basket for manual checkout. Automatic prepares a draft order, reserves for24h, then requires explicit buyer confirmation before shop processing. No automatic money debit.
rules.schedule: Store entered device-local date/time as UTC instant and show timezone. Do not silently reinterpret on device timezone change. Processing may occur within an hour. Sample creation16Nov10:00, deadline17Nov10:00, receipt17Nov12–15.
rules.receiving: Reuse block31 address+Geoapify/OSM and block37 shop-configured intervals, whole day, agreement or pickup. Phone is already taken from authenticated account. Revalidate on every run.
rules.money: Current catalog/SKU prices, stock, minimum order, zone/fees, currency and payment availability rechecked. Auto discounts only when currently eligible. No silent spend of wallet/cashback or reuse of previous promo. Whole-currency display uses existing global rounding.
rules.draft: Back from address, authorization, notification setup or failed save preserves draft and return intent. Do not overwrite existing basket without merge/replace choice; cap merged quantities at current stock.
rules.consent: Default unchecked: notification consent and automatic-order consent are separate. Partial and fully confirmed fixtures included. Save only after required consent and notification channel is available.
rules.notifications: Telegram primary with verified bot deep-link handoff and automatic return; quiet lower phone fallback. Phone account needs a permitted browser notification channel or connected Telegram. Show failed delivery in account, no promises of delivery.
rules.operations: Editing and one-time skip preserve schedule. Pause/resume retains rhythm without catching up missed cycles. Cancelling schedule retains already placed orders. Skip is distinct from timeout/cancellation.
rules.exceptions: Quantity reduction, all unavailable, changed price, unavailable receiving time, spending cap, minimum basket, previous unresolved order, expired confirmation, service pause, disabled creation, load/save errors, loading and notification failure covered.
rules.payment: Reuse approved block39 native cash/transfer UI in this order context with468 /488 /goods-only418 amounts. Unknown delivery paid separately to configured recipient; no automatic additional debit.
rules.identity: Account scoped schedules. Revalidate current account on every asynchronous response; logout cannot expose previous buyer schedules. Names, phone, product availability and flags are backend data.

implementationGaps: Current supplied frontend has create, preview, status pause/resume/cancel; standalone list, editing and one-time skip are proposed changes requiring API support.
Existing requireGrowthCloud/identity paths use Telegram; the accepted quiet phone fallback requires consistent account/session support and available browser notification channel.

Accepted receiving modes (interval/day/agreement), delivery paid separately and global integer rounding must be applied consistently to recurring backend snapshots; frontend files alone cannot verify backend support.
Native Figma is a fixed example prototype, not live editable data or working API. Auth timer only simulates a verified-session event in the prototype; runtime must never authenticate on a timer.
Some form fields and cross-flow examples are static fixture interactions; implementation must preserve mode/period/draft/amount and contextual return instead of copying fixture values.
scope: Native editable Figma only. No production code changes, Telegram commands, notification permissions, actual orders or payments.
visualReview: Passing mobile overview and reminder/price/paused previews, desktop setup and basket inspected. Temporary preview boards removed; canonical native states retained.
basketFixture: Two products, one each:189+229=418; delivery50, total468. No carried promo/cashback debit; empty inline promo entry. Merchant-enabled programs use approved block33 controls.

finalAudit.scope: Native Figma design and prototype links; no production runtime execution
